title: Rare & Uncommon Investment Tier List
subject: Every fully evolved rare & uncommon species in the game (304), simulated at Lv 100, rank 5

board.title: Rare & Uncommon Investment Tier List — v0.5.161

method.summary: Every fully evolved rare and uncommon species in the game (304) was simulated at Lv 100, rank 5 in the game's own battle engine. An Elite team can field only one Legendary, so 5 of the 6 Elite slots are non-legendaries: those are the Pokémon worth ranking up. Rare ones rank up with rare gems of their types, uncommon ones with cheaper uncommon gems; each rank gives ×1.15 stats. This rerun is on v0.5.161: draining moves no longer heal, status moves land 75% at most, and repeated Sleep/Freeze/Paralysis gets resisted. Simisage, Simisear and Simipour are now Rare, and the seasonal Sawsbuck forms are counted. How it is measured: the best unranked team for each of 45 Elite legendary fights and 10 Elite League fights, at the tier where it first wins under half the time; each candidate at *5 is put in its best slot, 16–32 fights each with the same random draws for all. Underground: put in the best trio for each of the 6 themes. Score = average of the three areas (100 = the best of all 304 there).

algorithm.goal: Rank the 304 fully evolved rare and uncommon species by how much a rank-5 copy adds across Elite fights, Elite Leagues and the Underground.
algorithm.engine: The game's own battle engine at build d8622a1fb3
steps: Start from the best unranked team for each of 45 Elite legendary fights and 10 Elite League fights.
Raise each fight to the tier where the unranked team first wins under half the time.
Put each candidate at *5 in its best slot, next to the rest of the team as it would fight.
Run 16–32 fights per candidate with the same random draws for every candidate.
Put each candidate in the best trio for each of the 6 Underground themes.
Score each area against the best of all 304 in that area (100 = best), then average the three areas.

acceptance.sameDraws: Every candidate uses the same random draws, so the order is not seed luck.
acceptance.scale: 100 = the best of all 304 in that area; the tier score is the average of the three.

gameFacts: An Elite team fields only one legendary, so 5 of 6 slots are non-legendaries.
Rare species rank up with rare gems of their types; uncommon species with cheaper uncommon gems.
Status moves land 75% at most and repeated Sleep/Freeze/Paralysis gets resisted (v0.5.13).
Simisage, Simisear and Simipour are Rare in v0.5.161; seasonal Sawsbuck forms are counted.

notes: Simisage, Simisear and Simipour are now Rare.
Pseudo-legendaries are not counted in the Top 10 Rare list (they are shown separately).

uncertain: The board's Top 10 Uncommon prints three of its first five names as sprites only; the OCR recovered Golurk, Dewgong, Darmanitan, Froslass, Granbull and Hariyama, so those six are stored and the rest omitted rather than invented.
Mamoswine's points read 'MA' and Glaceon's are cut off; 71 and 64 are best reads, not confirmed digits.
Darmanitan's 54 pts is printed in the second row group above the 52/51 of the first group; kept as read, so the stored top list is not strictly descending.
One best-area label reads 'Bite #57/#12 of 304' in the OCR; stored as 'Elite' where the column header makes that the likely word.
